title: Jordan's MRI shows dense white matter in the caudate and putamen
summary: Jordan tells of Jordan's MRI shows dense white matter in the caudate and putamen, about 2020s at unspecified, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: really great research like I have a very unique codate and pudamin

plain: A man called Jordan, who says he was taken into a secret UFO programme as a child, says that a brain scan in the 2020s showed unusual dense tissue in two deep parts of his brain, the caudate and the putamen. He links this to research by a scientist, Garry Nolan. He tells it as possible physical proof that his brain is different, perhaps tied to the mental abilities he describes.
